chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever looks at my private parts other than Ali is a disbeliever.
ai.seo_question: Who is the only person allowed to look at the Prophet's private parts according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, underscores the unique spiritual and physical honor bestowed upon Imam Ali (a.s.) as the sole companion permitted to view the Prophet’s private parts, a privilege often interpreted in Shia scholarship as a sign of his purity (Ismah) and closeness to the Prophet. The designation of 'kafir' for others highlights not merely a physical restriction but a theological distinction, affirming Ali’s exclusive status among the companions. This narrative reinforces the concept of the Prophet’s family as the keepers of his inner and outer sanctity.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-237 According to the same documentation, the Prophet (S) said,
“Should anyone but Ali (a.s.) look at my private parts he would be an atheist.”
